breakdown.description: The asymmetric support pair is replaced by the same roller direction on both vertical edges
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to use the same roller direction (u_x = 0) on both vertical edges, contradicting the primary instruction for asymmetric support. The agent correctly ignored this error and implemented the asymmetric constraints as specified in the ground truth: 'left edge (x = 0) has u_y = 0 (vertical fixation), right edge (x = 1) has u_x = 0 (horizontal fixation)'.
